name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
body: The Engagement Operations Specialist role is built around a real operational problem: keeping an agreement or renewal moving when it touches several stakeholders and a customer's own approval calendar. That has been my job in B2B SaaS for 15 years, usually inside a faster sales cycle than education purchasing runs on.

Salesforce has been my primary CRM at two employers, Birdeye and Wix, where I managed account and pipeline records, renewal-relevant customer health data, and cross-functional communication. At Birdeye I onboarded and managed 15 to 20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one. At Level Agency I advised client businesses directly on ad-spend budget planning and allocation. Across every role, the common thread is being the person who keeps a multi-stakeholder process, an implementation, a renewal, an agreement, from stalling.

I don't have direct K-12 or school-district purchasing experience, and I want to say that plainly rather than imply otherwise. What I bring is the deal-coordination and CRM discipline this role runs on, and I would learn the education-purchasing specifics fast. I would welcome the chance to talk through how I would approach the first 90 days.
